description: This file contains a PHP class 'EmployeeAllowedSkillAPI' which extends 'Endpoint' and implements 'CollectionEndpoint'. It provides an API endpoint for listing the allowed skills for a specific employee within a Human Resource Management system. The class handles request validation, service initialization, and retrieves data about employee skills using associated service and DAO classes.
